P24b is broken SQL. Inside a GROUP BY b.id group, count(DISTINCT b.id) is always 1, the HAVING sums price_incl_tax*quantity across lines that may have mixed currencies, and TABLESAMPLE is placed before a JOIN without an alias. Rewrite it as a CTE: sample baskets, sum lines per (basket, currency), join the active cap, then aggregate over_cap and over_cap_no_order via a LEFT JOIN to order_order.basket_id.

P15 does not actually compute guest vs registered conversion. Add a basket-side query: TABLESAMPLE basket_basket LEFT JOIN order_order ON o.basket_id=b.id, grouped by (b.guest_id IS NOT NULL), with orders/baskets. basket_basket.date_created is unindexed, so sampling is required.
